title:
Comment of Jolene Weiss in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/6/2026

documents.name: 152390.txt
documents.text:
Jolene Weiss, Clinton Township, NJ.
I am writing to express my strong opposition to DeepGreen’s proposed underwater data center project in Cook Inlet (Docket No. P-15423-000). The Cook Inlet beluga whale population is critically endangered, down to roughly 331 individuals, and their entire designated critical habitat is already heavily burdened by industrial noise, shipping, and development.
Introduction of 350 tidal turbines, 66 subsea data pods, associated construction noise, and unmodeled thermal waste heat directly threatens these marine mammals and local salmon runs. Even preliminary survey and permit activities risk irreparable harm to a species that cannot afford further degradation of its home.

I urge FERC to deny DeepGreen’s application.
